articleTitle: Evaluate temperature distribution based on Douglas ADI
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: In the process of solidification, the metal properties such as thermal conductivity, density will have great changes, the time step will be changed at any time if we use explicit difference scheme. In order to simplify the calculation, we usually calculate with the metal properties held constant, and this makes the calculation results in large errors. In this paper, we will use Douglas ADI (alternating direction implicit) to calculate the temperature distribution of LPDC wheel hub. This method with unconditional stability can deal with the changes of the metal properties. In addition, it will reduce the computing time. At last, we will give the comparison between the simulation results and the experimental results.

articleTitle: Issues and trends in powder injection molding ressearch and applications
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Powder injection molding (PIM) is one of the most important manufacturing processes. PIM is a net-shape fabrication technology that combines the complex shapeforming ability of plastic injection molding, the precision of die-casting, and the material selection flexibility of powder metallurgy. This paper discusses about many ongoing issues and trends of increasing attentions and interests on PIM research and applications. Furthermore, future research directions on simulation, optimization and informatics are discussed.

articleTitle: Effect of laser surface hardening on pitting corrosion resistance of AM50 magnesium alloy
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: The influence of laser shock processing (LSP) on pitting corrosion of AM50 magnesium alloy in chloride solution was evaluated. Bright shallow dimples were formed after laser shock processing, and surface changes were accompanied by small roughening effects. Plastic deformation occurred and compressive residual stress formed in the surface layer. The compressive residual stress on the surface reached 146MPa with laser power density of about 3GW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The electrochemical polarization curve showed that the corrosion potential and pitting potential of the LSP sample increased 85mV and 153mV as compared to the untreated sample, respectively, while the corrosion current density was about one order of magnitude lower. After 5 hours immersing in the chloride solution, many pits appeared on the surface of untreated samples, while few pits appeared in the LSP samples. The pitting corrosion resistance of the LSP AM50 was improved significantly; a beneficial influence of laser surface hardening has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimization design and fracture analysis of shift fork shaft of the transmission
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Taking the shift fork shaft of transmission as research object, through analyzing the position and shape of the fracture on shift fork shaft, the paper gives the optional design scheme of shift fork shaft. The three dimensional mathematical model of the optimized shift fork shaft is set up by use of Pro/E software and the finite element analysis is carried out by ANSYS Workbench software. The analysis results show the strength of the optimized shift fork shaft can meet the design requirement.

articleTitle: Finite element method analyses the bending intensity of gear
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: According to the equation of flank profile parameter, finite element model was established and the tooth bending stress analysis was analyzed based on annoys environment. Especially detailed compared to the transition curve stress analysis of different round angle and different load location. Finite Element Method analyse than the tradition algorithm is more accurate, It have provided a basis for the curved intensity's calculation of gear.

articleTitle: Development of evaluation system for green product design based on energy consumption indicators
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: To establish evaluation system for green product design is the premise of implementing green manufacturing. Through the analysis of the product green design process, evaluation factors and evaluation goals, we build the product green design evaluation system and evaluation principles, and proposed a evaluation ideas based on energy consumption of the product green design. Using the energy consumption calculation and analysis about product green design elements, the way of product green design evaluation system is given. So the energy consumption in the stages of material selection, product production and repair need to be firstly calculated for identifying the energy consumption indicators. Finally, the approach is validated by applying it into the green design of flange ring.

articleTitle: Transmission box lightweight analysis based on ANSYS Workbench
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: This paper introduces the analytical step of transmission box lightweight. First, Pro/E software is used to establish the three dimensional Mathematical Model of the box, then ANSYS Workbench software is applied to carry out the finite element analysis. After the data are post-processed by ANSYS Workbench, the stress, strain and deformation of the box are obtained, which provides a basis for the optimization of transmission boxes.

articleTitle: Optimization parameters of plastic injection process based on CAE analysis of injection defect
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Aimed at cavitations, weld, warp age and other defects, defects in plastic injection and its influencing factors were analyzed, the constitutive model of the injection was established, mechanical model and boundary conditions of injection melding were determined. Then the injection simulation of different parameters was carried out on the platform of Mudflow. Combined with the actual experiment, the reasonable processes parameters and methods on reducing cavitations, weld, warp age and other defects was found. The result was a useful exploration for low carbon manufacturing in plastic injection, so it had certain practical value.

articleTitle: The application of Virtual Reality Technology in platen die-cutting machine design-manufacturing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: The emergence of Virtual Reality Technology provides an effective way to solve problems in the process of traditional product development, and brings the changing of method and conception in production field. The characteristics of Virtual Reality Technology and product development process are expounded. Then the Virtual Reality Technology's necessity and significance as well as the existing key technical problems in post-press processing equipment — die-cutting machine design and manufacture are analyzed. Finally in the foundation of research development and achievements of movement characteristics and elastic dynamics, for example of dual-elbow-bar mechanism, its motion simulation is realized on the basis of the nodes using Eon Studio.

articleTitle: A simulation study on deformation behavior of IN690 super alloy tube during hot extrusion process
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Based on the results of isothermal compression test of IN690 super alloy for constitutive relationship and ring compression test for interface friction factor, a finite element model for Ni-based super alloy IN690 tube during hot extrusion process is established by using DEFORM-2D. High temperature, high speed and high load are considered in the model. Extrusion load in steady process for the typical size is in good agreement with the measured result. The extrusion load, billet temperature field, stress field, strain field and the strain rate field during deformation process are obtained. Simulation results show that extrusion process can be divided by upsetting, filling, steady-state extrusion and end-stage extrusion. Little change of temperature occurs in upsetting and filling stages extrusion. The maximum temperature increase of billet appears at peak load and stable value 50°C is obtained in steady-state extrusion. Temperature decrease of billet rises up as extrusion process goes on. The maximum of equivalent strain appears at peak load. The maximum equivalent stress increases rapidly to a peak value in initial stage, and rises up slowly in steady-state extrusion process. Equivalent strain and equivalent strain rate keep unchanged in steady-state extrusion.

articleTitle: The application of sand-mold milling technology in the rapid manufacturing of automotive parts
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: As market competition becomes more intense, the development trend of manufacture is multi-variety, small batch, individuation and minor-cycle more and more obviously. Traditional casting technology with mold manufacturing cannot adapt to the active demand of short delivery date, higher precision, low cost in developing the parts of automobile engine, cover panels pattern etc. Rapid Prototyping technology and NC machining technology begin to be applied to rapid manufacturing of mold. A new rapid manufacturing technology and equipment called Sand-mold Milling was development by China Academy of Machinery Science and Technology, which was successfully used to realize the trial metalwork of automobile-engine parts.

articleTitle: An research on unloading device in preventing apple injury in grading equipment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Apple is a kind of skin easily damaged fruit, this dissertation takes the apple as the research object, we report a discharge device it can prevent the apple skin to be damaged by the external force when the visual grading equipment is working. Through the research of force analysis and unloading process of the apple on the discharge device, it realized the apple can rolled in or slide in the hopper slowly, the device has wide application range and can be applied in many kinds of fruit and vegetable its skin is easy to be damaged by the external force. Thus the device improves grading quality and the commodity processing value.

articleTitle: Based on the knowledge base of die castion mold material selection and auxiliary design expert systerm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Based on database technology and designing method of modular, adopting production rules to express knowledge, a model of intelligent system was created to realize high-quality, low cost, and short cycle. Use Visual Basic6.0 as a development tool and use Access2007 database technology to develop the system. Practice shows that The system can provide a reasonable design guidelines for the die casting mold designing.

articleTitle: The research on organ printing technology & equipment
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Organ printing technology and equipment is integrated innovation of mechanical, control, materials, biological field, which is key development of advanced forming technology in the future. This paper introduce the forming technology of organ printing principle and the performance of the forming device, including motor system, material injection system, cooling system and ultraviolet disinfection components, it provides sterile and clean forming environment for printing experiment. The realization of the organ printing forming technology not only widened the area of manufacturing, but also puts forward new biology and manufacturing technology problem, it can be developed into comprehensive course of biological medicine, advanced manufacturing, tissue engineering, promote the development of biomedicine, integrate biological medicine and advanced manufacturing technology.

articleTitle: 3D weaving forming technology and equipment for composites
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Composites have been used in industry because of the advantage of lightweight and high strength. It has raised attention for its excellent performance which are widely researched in various countries in the world, such as USA and Germany, and applied in fields such as automobiles and aviation. Based on the study of international and domestic forming technology for composites, this paper gives an analysis on the features of the current typical 3D weaving forming technology, indicating the direction of the development of the 3D weaving forming technology for composites in the future.

articleTitle: The effect of overheating treatment on the microstructure of TbDyfe alloys
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Effects of the overheating treatment on the microstructures and crystal orientation of the Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.27</inf>Dy<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.73</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.9</inf> compound have been investigated. The results indicate that different overheating conditions obtain different microstructures and crystal orientation. It is concluded that overheating treatment remarkable affected the pattern and mode of Tb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.27</inf>Dy<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.73</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1.9</inf> solidification. The conjectural discussions of the results were also present.

articleTitle: Study on choice of guide sleeve material based on 3D hybrid woven forming of composites
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: The guide sleeve is the connection between layers during the 3D hybrid woven of large and complex component based on digital guiding master plate. Proper choice of guide sleeve materials is essential to the whole performance of composites, for both the guide sleeve and the fiber coiled on it for plane shaping are reinforcing materials. Thus not only the properties of guide sleeve should be deliberated, but also their interfacial bonding properties between resins and guide sleeve should be taken into consideration while choosing the material. After testing the interface tensile strength by universal testing machine, we use the scanning electron micro-scope (SEM) to analyze the joint surface morphology of composites before and after tensile test. And the result shows that carbon fiber-vinyl composite has excellent invasive between resins and high bonding strength. Meanwhile, because of its high specific strength, compared with aluminum alloy and stainless steel, carbon fiber-vinyl composite material is the perfect selection for guide sleeve.

articleTitle: Discuss designing-method of transmission synchronizer
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: This paper introduces the working principle of transmission synchronizer, lists the designing formula of transmission synchronizer, certitudes the designing method or range of the designing formula's parameters, and sets up the designing principle of transmission synchronizer. Currently, the synchronizer has been widely used in mechanical gear transmission. Due to using it, the performance of the manual-transmission has been greatly improved. It not only makes gear shift more portable without impact, but also improved the average expectancy life of the transmission and the automobile transmission system. Moreover, it improves the automobile's power and fuel economy. The change of the operational method reduces driver's fatigue and increases the driver's sense of security and comfort. For the reasons above, the manufacturers in domestic production of automotive transmissions all use the synchronizer structure <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1] [3] [4] [5]</sup>.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on gating and riser system of large complicated steel castings
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: In this paper, gating and riser system of large complicated steel casting of the studied were designed firstly, then temperature and flow fields of this casting in a casting process were simulated and analyzed, and generation of shrinkage and porosity during solidification process was predicted. Finally, a more reasonable gating and riser system was obtained by analysis of simulation results. The research results in this paper have certain guiding significances for the determination of casting technology of large complicated steel castings in practical productions.

articleTitle: The design-manufacturing technology and the trends of the development of full automatic plane die-cutting machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of packaging industry, the request for die-cutting technology and the performance of die-cutting machine is much higher, and it has been paid much more attention by industry. Through the comparison of domestic and international die-cutting technology situation, the differences between them and defects of domestic machine were analyzed from the design method, and the digital design and virtual prototype design were put forward to compensate these shortages. With the survey and analysis of domestic die-cutting machine manufacturing process and technology, taking the key parts processing for example, die-cutting machine manufacturing technology status was expounded, then on the basis of relevant patent technique and market research, development trends of die-cutting equipment and several new problems brought by them were listed.

articleTitle: Study on automatic feeding in hot stamping production line
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: The material feeding in hot stamping is quite different from traditional cold stamping. This paper described some key issues of automatic high-temperature steel plate feeding. some analysis and studies were done about gripping method, clamping force, local and whole plate temperature drop in transferring process, and some ideas about robot manipulator' design were proposed with that.

articleTitle: High strength steel in the applation of lightweight design of loader boom
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Boom, an important part of the loader, in the text, high strength steel material used to the lightweight design, and the boom yield strength 345 MPa of Q345 steel material to substituted for 600 MPa of high strength steel, according to original boom the thickness of the structure to determine the thickness of the boom of high strength steel, and build the lightweight boom model. According to the working equipment of loader shoveling into the working condition, on the original boom and lightweight boom by finite element analysis respectively, by comparing the original lightweight boom and boom of the finite element analysis, determine that the lightweight boom meet the job requirements of the loader, and provides research foundation for engineering machinery lightweight.

articleTitle: Grinding wheel dressing technology for gear form grinding machine tools
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Gear form grinding technology is widely used in the process of gear manufacturing. Grinding wheel dressing is the key technology of gear form grinding process. In this paper, several different grinding wheel dressing methods and the corresponding diamond roller dressing device are simply introduced. The technical parameters of grinding wheel dressing are respectively analyzed, including dressing speed ratio, overlap ratio, dressing depth and axial speed. The experimental tests of gear form grinding are carried out to investigate the effects of dressing parameters on the grinding process. The results of analysis and manufacturing tests can provide the reliable basis for diamond roller dressing in gear form grinding machine tools.

articleTitle: Joining strength and interfacial microstructure of brazing superalloy and 3D-Cf/SiC
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: The interfacial microstructure and joining strength of GH2907-interlayre, interlayer-Cf/SiC of GH2907 and 3D-Cf/SiC ceramic matrix composite brazed by Nickel-based high temperature brazing filler were researched in this paper. The result indicated that the interlayer thickness of tungsten alloy has great influence on joining strength. According to the experiment condition, the optimum thickness of interlayer is 1.5mm, and the four-point bending strength of joint reaches to 109MPa, meeting the strength requirement of brazing.\The joint structure after brazing is: GH2907-(compound of Ni-B and Nickel-based solid solution containing niobium/Tungsten alloy/solid solution of Au-Ni/compound of Ni-Si/layer of Cr<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and other carbide)-Cf/SiC. Additionally, the interface between filler metals and Cf/SiC is very tight and the microstructure of tungsten alloy does not change abnormally.

articleTitle: Material flow behaviour of 2024-T351 aluminium alloys friction stir welding
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Copper strips (0.1mm thick) were used as markers to investigate the metal flow during friction stir welding. After welding, radiography and metallurgical sectioning were used to investigate the marker movement. The scope of this investigation is to evaluate the effect of shoulder and probe on the material flow and oxide in different welding parameters. The results of this study indicate that the shoulder produces a grind effect and the probe produces an effective fragmentation and dispersion, on the other hand, with the increase of heat input, the effect of fragmentation and dispersion is decreased.

articleTitle: Design & manufacture and material performance
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: The choice of materials and improvement of the material properties shall be the material basis to the industrial product design and manufacture. As for any product design and manufacture, the purpose and requirements of the design and manufacture may be realized only if the property characteristics of the selected material are consistent with its machining technologies; moreover, the true use value and the aesthetic value may be realized and the inward functions and surface characteristics of the material may be displayed only through the design and manufacture. Therefore, the influence on the performance improvement and enhancement of the design and manufacture material finished products due to the improvement and enhancement of the material property/properties has been introduced emphatically in this study; in addition, the influence on the performances of the material finished products by the selection of the common materials during the design and manufacture processes has been elaborated.

articleTitle: Fabrication of large scale superhydrophilic/superhydrophobic pipes
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: Superhydrophilic/superhydrophobic surfaces have beenfabricated by various methods for years. However it haddifficulties to fabricate large or 3 dimensional superhydrophilic/superhydrophobic surfaces due to limitation offabrication process. Here we report a new fabrication processof superhydrophilc/superhydrophobic surfaces usinganodizing and HDFS coating. With this fabrication process, large scale and 3 dimensional superhydrophilic/superhydrophobicsurfaces can be easily fabricated. Contact anglemeasurement and surface structures study were carried out toexpress these surfaces.

articleTitle: Continuous casting of metal hollow profiles with low plasticity under the condition of complex physical fields constrained
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: In order to manufacturer high-density, low plasticity of metal hollow sections of pipes efficiently, It could not simply follow the tradition of single casting ways and technological means, but open up a new way that metallurgy, physics and mechanics and other means integrating and compositing. Modifying th e horizontal continuous casting equipment and mould so that the electromagnetic fields, ultrasonic field, and gravity field involved the temperature field above the superimposed and let it also involved in forming the hollow shell of the constraints, then not only in appearance can be a continuous casting of arbitrary length, near-final-shaped hollow profiles, but also to achieve high performance and zero-defect, and tough, got the quality targets. Using the technology of "Forming continuous casting hollow bars in complex-physics field constrained", we have begun mass-scale production of hollow profiles of cast iron, because of its superior quality and price-performance ratio, they are widely used in automotive engines like Dry Cylinder Liner/Piston Rings, sleeves used in railway vehicles, machine tools, oil drilling, metallurgical machinery, engineering machinery, chemical pumps, compressors and other industries.

articleTitle: Study on lubrication of large-scale numerical control radial-axial direction rolling ring machine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Advanced Technology of Design and Manufacture (ATDM 2011)
abstract: In this article, according to the actual working condition of key friction-pair of numerical control 8000 mm radial-axial direction rolling ring machine, optimization design of the lubricating system was researched. Reasonable lubrication technology schemes were proposed for main transmission box, guide rail, rollers, satisfied the request of heavy load, variable load and high temperature. After system experiments, special lubricants used for numerical control 8000 mm radial-axial direction rolling ring machine were developed.
